mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM question WHERE id = #{questionId} AND status = 'ENABLED'
SELECT id FROM profile WHERE id = #{profileId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, profile_id AS "profileId", question_id AS "questionId", stage, mastery_level AS "masteryLevel", attempt_count AS "attemptCount", wrong_count AS "wrongCount", wrong_book_active AS "wrongBookActive", last_studied_at AS "lastStudiedAt", version, created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM study_progress WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} AND question_id = #{questionId}

INSERT INTO study_progress (profile_id, question_id, stage, mastery_level, attempt_count, wrong_count, wrong_book_active, last_studied_at) VALUES (#{profileId}, #{questionId}, 'PRACTICING', #{masteryLevel}, 1, CASE WHEN #{wrong} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, #{wrong}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (profile_id, question_id) DO UPDATE SET stage = 'PRACTICING', mastery_level = EXCLUDED.mastery_level, attempt_count = study_progress.attempt_count + 1, wrong_count = study_progress.wrong_count + CASE WHEN #{wrong} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, wrong_book_active = study_progress.wrong_book_active OR #{wrong}, last_studied_at = EXCLUDED.last_studied_at, version = study_progress.version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING id, profile_id AS "profileId", question_id AS "questionId", stage, mastery_level AS "masteryLevel", attempt_count AS "attemptCount", wrong_count AS "wrongCount", wrong_book_active AS "wrongBookActive", last_studied_at AS "lastStudiedAt", version, created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt"

SELECT q.id AS "questionId", q.title, q.star_level AS "starLevel", p.mastery_level AS "masteryLevel", p.attempt_count AS "attemptCount", p.wrong_count AS "wrongCount", p.last_studied_at AS "lastStudiedAt" FROM study_progress p JOIN question q ON q.id = p.question_id WHERE p.profile_id = #{profileId} AND p.wrong_book_active = TRUE AND q.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY p.last_studied_at DESC, p.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE study_progress SET wrong_book_active = FALSE, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} AND question_id = #{questionId} AND wrong_book_active = TRUE
